name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
short: Google's fast multimodal reasoning model (1M/65K, $1.50/$9) for coding/agents; GPQA 92.2% and SWE-bench 78.8%.
modalities: Text, image, audio, PDF in; text out
freeTierNote: Free tier available on Google AI Studio and OpenCode Zen with standard rate limits
standout: Fast multimodal reasoning for coding and agents — the Flash generation that first made near-Pro quality feel instant.
tradeoff: Positioned awkwardly in hindsight: 3.6/3.7 Flash deliver more capability at comparable prices, so it mostly serves existing deployments.
